name: event_holdout_v1
unit: flood event, never chip or pixel
rationale: M1 inspected Bolivia, Ghana and Spain labels for feasibility. Spain is therefore reserved for exploratory case-study mapping and excluded from the untouched final benchmark test. Nigeria and Somalia source labels were not opened for method selection at freeze. Event-group results have few independent final groups and must report that limitation.
selection_rule: No test labels, thresholds, model outputs or class balance were used to select final_test events.
official_split_use: Secondary chip-level benchmark comparison only; it shares event groups across train, validation and test.
